The desktops mentioned above include Office Productivity software (MS Office) and a

Following general guidelines are to be followed while applying the norms as detailed

All procurements should be made strictly in accordance with provisions of
General Financial Rules, 2005 as amended from time to time and other
instructions and guidelines on the subject as applicable.

A judicious view must be taken on the requirements projected by offices ensuring

that procurements are not in excess of requirements and shall not exceed the
norms in any case.

c. The norms are to be used by the competent authority under the delegation of
powers available to them. The revised delegation of power is being issued
separately.

d. The norms as above shall be applied duly taking into account the existing It
Hardware present in the respective offices and the total numbers of systems in an
office should not exceed the quantity permissible under the norms.

e. Policy for obsolescence of IT equipments exists and Regional Commissioner, In-
Charge of regions is empowered to purchase items declared obsolete as per the
policy.

f. The IS Division of Headquarters would be responsible for laying down the

specifications of the equipments and updating them from time to time keeping
in view the requirements and the changing technology environments. The field
offices would be required to make the purchases at their level on the basis of the
specification laid down by IS Division.

7. The recommended specifications of laptops and peripherals is also enclosed herewith.

8. Kindly acknowledge the receipt of communication.

(This issues with the approval of CPFC)
